content_sections.text: Junior Lecturer: Master's degree in the subject concerned from a recognized University with at least 55% marks or its equivalent grade with a minimum Second division in the Bachelor's Degree. M.Phil., Ph.D. will be considered as added qualification. Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper: Master's Degree/Graduation in concerned subject with Second division in Honours.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Aeronautics Education Society Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://hal-india.co.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 25-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Aeronautics Education Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Aeronautics Education Society Recruitment 2026 is 25 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the specified address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Lecturer and Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies. 3 posts are for Junior Lecturer and 2 posts are for Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for both Junior Lecturer and Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper posts is between 21 to 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Lecturer post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Lecturer post, candidates need a Master's degree in the subject concerned with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) and a Second division in Bachelor's Degree. M.Phil./Ph.D. is an added qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper post should have a Master's Degree or Graduation in the concerned subject with a Second division in Honours.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications by post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Junior Lecturer and Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for Junior Lecturer is Rs. 22,000/- per month, and for Lab. Asst.-Store Keeper, it is Rs. 16,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Aeronautics Education Society located?
faq.answer: The Aeronautics Education Society is located in Sunabeda, Koraput, Odisha, with the pincode 763002.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.
